label: D1 after an unrewarded trial while the agent strongly favours a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), only when the reward input is 0 (never after reward), and essentially only when the agent is committed to a2 (prev_action 2 in 81% of mass, next action a2 in ~100% of defined cases; policy logit a1-a2 in [-8.9,-4.4] holds 88% of mass). Typical context: the previous a2 trial had a rare transition to S1 and was unrewarded (prev_common==0 & prev_action==2 alone: P 0.54 R 0.80), i.e. the model-based stay-on-a2 case, with S2 the good state (83% of mass). Recorded predicate uses only observed inputs plus the model own D1 policy readout: dev P 0.59 R 0.85 F1 0.70 mass recall 0.88. Adding ep_trial>=40 raises precision to 0.76 (F1 0.74): the feature is much more frequent late in episodes (rate rises from 0.5% at trials 0-9 to 3% at 60-89), which no observed variable captures cleanly. Strongest activations come after repeated unrewarded rare a2->S1 trials in a row. Does not fire after a1 choices, after rewarded trials, or when value is high (>7.54).
